yolov8n-pose.label: YOLOv8n-pose
yolov8n-pose.role: person detection, initial pose and periodic reacquisition
yolov8n-pose.filesNote: 8-bit quantized weights select/reacquire the person (boxes matched fp32 with IoU >= 0.97 on the test clip); fp32 weights load only if YOLO must supply measurement keypoints (MoveNet unavailable).

output.name: output0
output.fields: cx, cy, w, h, person score, 17 x (x, y, keypoint score) in 640x640 input pixels

yolov8n-pose.confidenceKind: YOLOv8 keypoint presence score (sigmoid); model-specific, not MediaPipe visibility

movenet-singlepose-lightning.label: MoveNet SinglePose Lightning
movenet-singlepose-lightning.role: continuous single-person pose on the selected person's crop

input.name: input
input.resize: square crop, zero padding outside the frame

output.name: output_0
output.fields: 17 x (y, x, score), normalised to the square crop

movenet-singlepose-lightning.confidenceKind: MoveNet heatmap score; model-specific, not MediaPipe visibility

vitpose-base-simple.label: ViTPose-B (simple decoder)
vitpose-base-simple.role: server-side selected-frame check on person boxes supplied by the tracker

input.resize: affine crop of the supplied COCO [x, y, w, h] box

output.fields: 17 COCO keypoints in image pixels with heatmap scores

vitpose-base-simple.confidenceKind: ViTPose heatmap maximum; model-specific, not MediaPipe visibility

depth.label: Landmark depth / distance from camera
depth.reason: The COCO-17 models return 2D image coordinates only. No depth is estimated.

world_coordinates.label: Metric 3D world coordinates
world_coordinates.reason: None of the three models estimate 3D world coordinates.

knee_flexion_3d.label: 3D knee flexion angle
knee_flexion_3d.reason: A true flexion angle needs 3D joint positions. Only 2D image-plane angles are available, and they change with camera position.

heel_toe_contact.label: Heel lift / toe contact
heel_toe_contact.reason: COCO-17 has ankles but no heel or toe landmarks, so foot contact cannot be assessed.

foot_progression.label: Foot progression angle
foot_progression.reason: Needs heel and toe landmarks, which these models do not provide.
